svg.title: MarsWalk Jezero Western Delta EVA Survival Map Card (v1.1.0)
svg.desc: Georeferenced Mars EVA hazard and route card derived from HiRISE 1 m/px DTM, Mars 2020 Perseverance waypoints, NASA xEVA slope/walkback rules, and Curiosity RAD proxy.
svg.text: MARSWALK — JEZERO WESTERN DELTA EVA SURVIVAL MAP CARD
CRS: IAU2015:49900 / Planetocentric East Sphere (R = 3,396,190 m) | Window: 1.90 km E-W x 2.00 km N-S | Contract v1.1.0 · Pack v1.1.0
GEOREFERENCED MULTI-SCALE HAZARD GRID (40x40 · 48.7 m) & OBSTACLE-AWARE EVA CORRIDORS

g.text: ◄ Rim Benchmark · Sol 1578 (77.258°E, ~6.7 km W · 20.68° NO_GO)

svg.text: 1. EVA CORRIDOR COMPARISON (STOP 1 SOL 413 -> STOP 3 SOL 753)
One-way: 2,213.6 m | Max 1 m DTM slope: 11.72° (<= 20.0°) | Duration: 4.27 h
Walkback tether: 1,925.7 m (<= 2,000 m) | Dose: 0.1192 mSv (proxy Curiosity RAD, Gale)
One-way: 2,290.4 m | Max slope: 11.41° | Duration: 4.19 h (10 m HiRISE grid)
Walkback: 1,927.7 m | Touches 2/82 obstacle polygons (vector check) | Dose: 0.1170 mSv (proxy Curiosity RAD, Gale)
Walkback 0.0 m · EVA Origin & Rover 3.0 m UHF Mast
Max rover tilt across all 708 mission stops
3. MULTI-SCALE HIRISE DTM SLOPE BASELINES (1,600 CELLS · 48.7 m)
Grid Verdicts (4 m / 16 m / 64 m): GO = 332 | CAUTION = 1,104 | NO_GO = 164
*1 m baseline retained for telemetry only: excluded from GO/NO_GO gating due to sub-post
pixel-scale noise (~3-4 post effective horizontal resolution on 1 m/px HiRISE stereo DTM).
4. SAFETY THRESHOLDS, COMMS/RADIATION CAVEATS & PACK SIGNATURE
• Limits [MEASURED]: Suit <= 20.0° (Apollo practical 15.0°) | Walkback <= 2.0 km | EVA 4-8 h
• GCR Surface Baseline: 0.67 mSv/day (proxy Curiosity RAD, Gale).
• Solar Storm Caveat: Local terrain blocks only a few percent of galactic cosmic rays;
it is not a shelter for a solar storm.
• Direct UHF Link (414.2 MHz, 1.8 m suit to 3.0 m Perseverance mast at Sol 413):
NO_GO on 1,347/1,600 cells (84%) with no direct line of sight (direct rover LOS, not orbital relay).
• Unavailable Layers (indeterminacy I = 1.0, never fabricated): crism_mtrdr_18m, meda_pds4_env, themis_ti_100m.
